title: Transport of a normalized native finite unit through a realization
statement: For schemes X and S, a morphism f, finite realizations eX and eS, a supplied coefficient derived model D and native derived model D', an identification hc with geoP1Pushforward and a FinitePushSquare, let a be an ordinary coefficient map from the regular module on S to the direct image of the regular module on X. Suppose m is a native constant-module map whose ordinary factorization through the realization unit isomorphisms is the given displayed equation, and suppose its canonical single-object derived comparison, transported through hc and the inverse finiteUnitComparison on X, is the inverse finiteUnitComparison on S followed by b. Then the realization of the derived ordinary a followed by the supplied derived square, hc and the target derivedUnit equals the source derivedUnit followed by b.

proof.text: Evaluate singlePushComparison_square at the regular coefficient module on X. Naturality of the exact single comparison moves a through eS. This is done in the proved generic transport_single_unit helper.

Use singlePushComparison_naturality on eX.unitIso.hom and naturality of eqToIso hc to put the target unit comparison in native coordinates. Map the supplied ordinary factorization equation by the single functor.

Compose the supplied native derived-unit equation with the source exact single comparison and the single of eS.unitIso.hom. Expand the two derivedUnit definitions and specialize the proved generic helper to the actual coefficient and native sheaf categories.

theorem finite_push_unit_transport
    (R : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R]
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (eX : FiniteRealization R A X) (eS : FiniteRealization R A S)
    (D : DiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar R f))
    (D' : DiagonalRightDerived (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f))
    (hc : D'.R = geoP1Pushforward A f) (s : FinitePushSquare R A f eX eS D D')
    (a : Mod.regular (condensedRingObj R S) ⟶
      (CondensedRing.lowerStar R f).obj (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj R X)))
    (b : geoP1Unit A S ⟶ (geoP1Pushforward A f).obj (geoP1Unit A X))
    (m : geoCartierConstant A S ⟶
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj (geoCartierConstant A X))
    (hm : eS.F.map a ≫ s.ordinary.hom.app _ ≫
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).map eX.unitIso.hom = eS.unitIso.hom ≫ m)
    (hn : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map m ≫
        singlePushComparison D' (geoCartierConstant A X) ≫
        (eqToIso hc).hom.app
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (geoCartierConstant A X)) ≫
        (geoP1Pushforward A f).map (finiteUnitComparison A X).inv =
        (finiteUnitComparison A S).inv ≫ b) :
    let t := s.derived.iso.hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft eX.F.mapDerivedCategory (eqToIso hc).hom
    eS.F.mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules R S) 0).map a ≫
          singlePushComparison D (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj R X))) ≫
        t.app (unit R X) ≫ (geoP1Pushforward A f).map eX.derivedUnit =
      eS.derivedUnit ≫ b
